> 第21章 重伤而逃（第1页）
虽然众人后悔，但是已经死人了。要不是自己冲在后面，那死的就是自己。
三方人看着那么多人拿不下黑袍之人，也是惊到对方实力强悍，天赋妖孽。化凡中期斩化神后期，如饮茶喝水一样。
看着那把熟悉的剑。田龙，元神宗几人都知道了。
李天？几人对视了一眼。剑太熟悉了，上次在宗门比武大会上给人的印象太深，所以知道，那把剑。
不知道他名字的人一脸懵逼。知道他的人唯有五毒宗、火神宗，还有元神宗几个人。
知道自己被认出来了，李天也不再躲躲藏藏的。同门人你还下杀手，忘记了副宗主的教诲吗？你们几个？。
这下人们听明白了，原来是元神宗之人，想必和这几人有仇。
少废话，我孙子被你废了。此仇怎么能不报？
哟，我当是谁，当初在青阳山抢我们东宝物的，还杀我们的人。我们没找上门你还送上门来了。
众人一听，这李天身上还有宝物，怕死的心再次燃起贪婪之火，都跃跃欲试的。
那你呢？李天看着鲁剑问道，我们好像从来没有仇。
哈哈，鲁剑大笑道，纯粹帮田龙凶。看你不爽，怎么样？这个理由合适吧？。
记住你说的话，还有你们，今日不死，他日必报。说着李天施展游龙步在人群中大杀了起来，这次生死危机，毕竟他只有化凡境中期，对面好几个天神境强者。不得不拿出十二分战力来拼命。
这小子诡异得很，大家注意。周杰喊了一声，他们几个都是化神巅峰，自己身边还有几个天神境强者，他们不信杀不了李天。
面对这么多人围攻，每一次边战边退，李天已经身受重伤。
砰的一声，李天后背再次中了周杰的一掌，倒飞出去。
顾不得看伤势，李天立马站了起来，开始突围。越战越勇，灵力也在消耗。不知不觉李天跑到了虎啸山内围。
而战场余波每一次轰鸣，树木倒一片，一只只妖兽境界低的直接被轰碎，纷纷跑开。

一只小狼被其余大狼扔下，惊慌失措的不知道往哪里跑。
李天一个飞扑，挡住了攻击，再次受伤。若不是李天挡下这击，小狼已经身死。
李天嘴角一口鲜血喷涌而出，染红了小狼脸，抱起小狼再次向前奔跑。后背承受了猛烈攻击。
几次险些站不起来了，凭借顽强的毅力站起来奔跑。
就要死了吗？有点不甘心。李天心里低吼道……灵力枯竭，再也没有一战之力。
而李天身后高手众多还在追着。被李天杀了的人也很多，上百人，都是化神境的。其中包括那皇子也是受了一些伤，要不是他身边的一个天神境老者，他早已身死道消。
就在这时李天怀里的小狼嘶吼一声。不一会儿一声响彻森林的狼声出现，震得那些天神境强者都头皮发麻。
糟糕，快走狼王出现了。皇子，神子赶紧跑。各自的身边高手护道者低呵一声，拉着自家公子就跑，没有管其他人。
随着他们这一跑，追杀的人知道不妙赶紧跑。他们不知不觉已经进入了虎啸山内围。所以众人拼命的跑，也不管伤势多重。
然而森林深处一帮狼奔腾而来，整齐有序，追着那些人就是撕咬。跑得慢的永远留在虎啸山，随着阵阵惨叫声落幕。终于森林里平静下来。

The latest chapter of The Great Emperor - Chapter 21 Escape with Serious Injury Page 1 - How long can the Great Emperor go in the future - Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 21 Escape with Serious Injury (Page 1)
Although everyone regretted it, people were already dead. If he hadn't rushed behind, he would have died.
Seeing that so many people were unable to defeat the man in black robe, the three parties were also shocked that the other party was powerful and talented. The middle stage of mortal transformation and the late stage of divine transformation are like drinking tea and water.
Looking at the familiar sword. Tian Long, everyone from the Yuanshen Sect knew about it.
Li Tian? Several people looked at each other. The sword is too familiar. It made such a deep impression on people at the sect martial arts competition last time, so I know that sword.
People who don't know his name are confused. The only people who knew him were the Five Poison Sect, the Fire God Sect, and a few people from the Yuanshen Sect.
Knowing that he had been recognized, Li Tian stopped hiding. Are you still killing fellow sect members and forgetting the teachings of the deputy sect leader? How many of you are there? .
Now people understood. It turned out to be someone from the Yuanshen Sect, and he must have had a grudge against these people.
Stop talking nonsense, my grandson has been ruined by you. How can you not avenge this?
Oh, who do I think he was, the one who robbed our east treasure in Qingyang Mountain and killed us? We didn't come to our door, but you delivered it to your door.
When everyone heard that Li Tian still had treasures on him, their fear of death ignited the fire of greed again, and they were all eager to try it.
What about you? Li Tian looked at Lu Jian and asked, "We never seem to have any grudges."
Haha, Lu Jian laughed and said, purely helping Tian Long murder. How about you feeling unhappy? Is this a suitable reason? .
Remember what you said, and you, if you don’t die today, you will be repaid tomorrow. As he said this, Li Tian used the Wandering Dragon Step and started killing people in the crowd. In this life-and-death crisis, after all, he was only in the middle stage of the Mortal Transformation Realm, and he faced several strong men in the Heavenly God Realm. He had to use twelve points of his combat power to fight for his life.
This guy is very weird, please pay attention. Zhou Jie shouted, they were all at the peak of god transformation, and there were a few strong men in the celestial realm around him. They didn't believe they couldn't kill Li Tian.
Faced with the siege of so many people, Li Tian was seriously injured every time he retreated while fighting.
With a bang, Li Tian was hit by Zhou Jie's palm again on the back and flew backwards.
Regardless of the injury, Li Tian immediately stood up and began to break out. The more he fights, the braver he becomes, and his spiritual power is also consumed. Unknowingly, Li Tian ran to the inner area of ​​Huxiao Mountain.
And every time the aftermath of the battlefield roared, the trees fell to pieces, and the low-level monsters were directly smashed into pieces and ran away one after another.
A small wolf was abandoned by the other big wolves and panicked and didn't know where to run.
Li Tian swooped to block the attack and was injured again. If Li Tian hadn't blocked the blow, Xiao Lang would have died.
A mouthful of blood spurted out from the corner of Li Tian's mouth, staining the little wolf's face red. He picked up the little wolf and ran forward again. The back took a heavy blow.
I almost couldn't stand up several times, but I stood up and ran with my tenacious perseverance.
About to die? A little unwilling. Li Tian roared in his heart... His spiritual power was exhausted and he no longer had the strength to fight.
And there are many masters behind Li Tian who are still chasing him. There were also many people killed by Li Tian, ​​hundreds of them, all of whom were in the God Transformation realm. Among them, the prince also suffered some injuries. If it weren't for an old man in the God Realm beside him, he would have died long ago.
At this moment, the little wolf in Li Tian's arms roared. After a while, a wolf sound resounded through the forest, shocking the scalps of those strong men in the God Realm.
Oops, hurry up and the Wolf King appears. Prince, Son of God, run away quickly. The master guardians around them let out a low voice, grabbed their young master and ran away, ignoring the others.
As they ran away, the pursuers knew something was wrong and ran away quickly. They had entered the inner area of ​​Huxiao Mountain without knowing it. So everyone ran as hard as they could, no matter how serious the injuries were.
However, a group of wolves galloped in from the depths of the forest, neatly and orderly, chasing those people and biting them. Those who run slowly will always stay in Huxiao Mountain, ended with bursts of screams. Finally the forest calmed down.
